design.scope: posthoc diagnostic on two previously inspected training failures; not representative, not training

arms.D: 4 same corrected-procedure without privileged hint SPS + 4 bare

sampler.SPS: frozen original Python hook and SGLang converters, draft_horizon=0
sampler.entropy_threshold: pooled top16 entropy 95th percentile on 8 independent bare calibration episodes, frozen for all B/C/D

design.pairing: same task/group/sample RNG seed across arms; bare rows are correlated paired controls, not independent observations
design.arm_order: seeded random order each replicate group
confounds: B-C combines correction, concision, wording and changed privileged hints
C-D differs in hint presence and length; no length-matched placebo
two cases previously examined; no generalization or GRPO learning claim
design.resource_policy: wait until original sequence completed_analysis AND GPU1 empty with >=35000MiB free for three checks; no job preemption
design.researcher: existing archived Qwen3.6-35B-A3B docs; no new teacher requests
